mentions.name: Extreme Puzzle Books
mentions.description: A series of hard puzzle books featuring sudoku, killer sudoku, and wordsearches restricted to five letters per grid. Every logic puzzle comes with an online step-by-step walkthrough showing how to solve it, and custom software generates, tests, and verifies the puzzles against difficulty requirements.
mentions.source_excerpt:
A series of actually hard puzzle books, so far sudoku, killer sudoku and some fiendish wordsearches that only use 5 letters per grid.
